protocol.timing: perf_counter_ns; preflight warm-up plus per-phase calibration; five repeats by default; adaptive batching capped at 65536 executions; raw elapsed batches and divisors saved
protocol.prepare: fresh state each execution; includes constructor and prior-state release within a timed batch
protocol.query: fresh prepared state outside each repeat; same prepared state reused within that repeat's timed query batch
protocol.total: fresh preparation plus all queries each execution; measured independently, not a sum of phase medians
protocol.excluded: input generation, correctness checks, printing, memory tracing, profiling, dashboard rendering
protocol.memory: separate fresh tracemalloc runs; current and peak bytes with prepared state and output alive; existing inputs excluded; not RSS or every native allocation
protocol.scope: single machine and seed; original/revised measured sequentially; scheduling, warm caches and allocator state can affect results; no confidence intervals
